repairs.chosen_repair: Restored the epistemic qualification with «وقد لا يكون الكتاب قد استوفى بعد…».
repairs.rationale: The English and frozen Arabic say coverage may be incomplete; the prior classical sentence asserted incompleteness categorically.
alternatives: Retaining the categorical wording was rejected because it changes modality.

expert_review.reason: This is a direct modality repair, not an unsettled technical term.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the predication to «فيصدق عليها كلا الأمرين: كونها عنصرًا وكونها مجموعة جزئية» while preserving the terminology token.
repairs.rationale: Both properties apply to the set; the former wording unnaturally made the set itself ‘the two things’.
alternatives: A shorter «فهي عنصر ومجموعة جزئية» is accurate but does not retain the source emphasis on both descriptions.

expert_review.reason: The repair is ordinary Arabic predication and preserves established terms.

repairs.chosen_repair: Required a nonempty family for generalized intersection and a nonempty index set only for the indexed-intersection abbreviation; union remains unrestricted.
repairs.rationale: With no ambient universe, the displayed predicate for an empty family is true of every object and does not define a set in the theory being taught.
alternatives: Defining the empty intersection relative to a fixed universe was not selected because this section introduces no such universe.

expert_review.reason: The missing hypothesis follows deterministically from the stated set-theoretic setting.

repairs.chosen_repair: Defined the local abbreviation by writing $I = \Id{\Nat}$ at first use and retained K and H.
repairs.rationale: Context identifies I as the natural-number identity relation, but the symbol had never been introduced.
alternatives: Replacing every I by the full identity macro was rejected as needlessly invasive.

expert_review.reason: The intended referent is uniquely recoverable from the adjacent definition.

repairs.chosen_repair: Used «الأشجار المنتهية» for finite trees and required a prefix-closed subtree to be nonempty.
repairs.rationale: «منتهيات الأشجار» can mean terminal parts, while the empty prefix-closed set has no root and therefore is not a tree under the stated definition.
alternatives: «الأشجار المحدودة» was not chosen because it may suggest boundedness rather than finiteness.

expert_review.reason: A mathematics-Arabic specialist could confirm corpus-wide preference between منتهية and other renderings of finite.
expert_review.question: Is «شجرة منتهية» the preferred canonical Arabic term for finite tree throughout the edition?

repairs.chosen_repair: Replaced the typo «ننفع» by «ننتفع» and stated injectivity with explicit universal/at-most-one scope.
repairs.rationale: The negative construction could express the weaker claim that not every output has multiple preimages; the new wording fixes quantifier scope.
alternatives: A pairwise implication definition was valid but rejected to keep the surrounding codomain-oriented exposition.

expert_review.reason: The quantifier scope and typographical repair are deterministic.

repairs.chosen_repair: Inserted -3 as the seventh value in the example table.
repairs.rationale: The displayed formula evaluates to f(7)=-3, so the omitted table entry was a concrete arithmetic inconsistency.
alternatives: Removing the f(7) column was rejected because it would conceal rather than repair the example.

expert_review.reason: Direct substitution in the displayed formula determines the value.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the triangular bound to j≤k and rewrote the inverse exercise to sort/reindex the image, use the inverse only on its domain, and distinguish finite-nonempty and empty cases.
repairs.rationale: k(k+1)/2 sums 0 through k; an arbitrary injection into the naturals can have a sparse image whose inverse is not itself an enumeration with the required index domain.
alternatives: Restricting the exercise to bijective pairing functions was valid but less general; changing k(k+1)/2 was rejected because it would break the pairing formula.

expert_review.reason: The mathematics is fixed, but an educator may prefer a shorter formulation that still distinguishes both enumeration conventions.
expert_review.question: Can the corrected exercise be shortened without losing the sparse-image, finite, and empty cases?

repairs.chosen_repair: Qualified the surjection characterization to nonempty enumerable sets.
repairs.rationale: There is no total map from the positive integers to the empty set, although the adopted definition counts the empty set as enumerable by a separate clause.
alternatives: Restating the complete disjunction ‘empty or admits a surjection’ was accurate but longer than the local qualification.

expert_review.reason: The empty-domain/codomain case is fixed by the definition.

repairs.chosen_repair: Replaced the finite n-zero word by the constant infinite zero sequence and removed the obsolete workaround.
repairs.rationale: A finite word is not an element of the displayed infinite-sequence codomain; the constant infinite sequence gives the intended non-surjective function.
alternatives: Padding the old underbrace notation by prose was rejected because the displayed value itself remained mistyped.

expert_review.reason: The codomain fixes the sequence type unambiguously.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed both empty-case formulas from g(x)=y to f(x)=y and removed compensating parenthetical explanations.
repairs.rationale: Only the given bijection f exists in the empty branch; g is introduced solely in the nonempty enumeration branch.
alternatives: Keeping the wrong symbol with a prose gloss was rejected because formal notation must state the actual argument.

expert_review.reason: Variable scope uniquely determines f.

repairs.chosen_repair: Required duplicate removal and reindexing before treating the image list of a surjection as a bijective enumeration.
repairs.rationale: A surjection may repeat values, whereas the selected alternative definition requires a bijection from an accepted index set.
alternatives: Switching the section to the surjection-based definition was rejected because the reader supports both configured definitions.

expert_review.reason: The distinction between surjective listing and bijective enumeration is mathematical, not terminological.

repairs.chosen_repair: Added both zero-product cases and normalized the zero cut from the unexplained superscript form to 0_Real.
repairs.rationale: The strict-sign cases omitted negative-times-zero and zero-times-negative; the embedding defines subscript Real notation for the zero cut.
alternatives: Folding zero into every sign branch was more repetitive; retaining the superscript notation would leave a type/notation inconsistency.

expert_review.reason: The missing cases and the locally defined zero notation determine the repair.

repairs.chosen_repair: Added 0≠1 to the ordered-field definition.
repairs.rationale: Without nontriviality, the one-element ordered ring satisfies the printed axioms and the inverse clause vacuously.
alternatives: Adding nontriviality to all commutative rings was rejected as a broader convention change than the defective field definition requires.

expert_review.reason: The one-element countermodel deterministically establishes the missing axiom.

repairs.chosen_repair: Compared an equivalence class with real zero and wrote the lower-bound comparison against the class [r], not the representative r.
repairs.rationale: Both changes keep the ordered objects in the quotient type explicitly defined by the construction.
alternatives: Relying on implicit embeddings was mathematically recoverable but rejected because this section is teaching the type distinction itself.

expert_review.reason: The construction fixes the types and notation locally.

repairs.chosen_repair: Made the successor characterization include zero; defined closure inside an ambient set A under a self-map f:A→A, restricted intersected sets to subsets of A, and used A itself as the closed witness.
repairs.rationale: The empty set is successor-closed but does not contain the naturals; without a self-map/ambient-set condition, iteration and the intersection witness are not generally valid.
alternatives: Using ran(f)∪{o} as witness can work under the corrected self-map hypothesis, but A itself is simpler and immediate.

expert_review.reason: The closure typing and zero condition are fixed by the definitions.

repairs.chosen_repair: Repaired the relative construction, replaced ambiguous «الحجتان» by «المدخلان», and typed generalized closure inside E under f:E→E with B⊆E; the theorem application now explicitly treats f:C→A⊆C as a self-map of C.
repairs.rationale: The prose grammar was broken; «الحجة» conflicts with logical argument; and unrestricted closure repeats the domain defect repaired in OLP-0051.
alternatives: «العنصران» is mathematically accurate; «المدخلان» was selected because it marks the elements’ functional role. A generic untyped closure was rejected.

expert_review.reason: No official mathematics-dictionary attestation was checked for function argument in this exact sense.
expert_review.question: Should function arguments here be standardized as «مدخلات» or «عناصر المجال» rather than «حجج»?

repairs.chosen_repair: Removed the unidiomatic «إحدى» before the singular formula token while preserving the universal valuation clause.
repairs.rationale: The sentence concerns one fixed formula being satisfied by every valuation, not one formula selected from a plurality.
alternatives: Replacing the token by bare «صيغة» was rejected because the terminology macro must remain traceable.

expert_review.reason: The grammatical number and logical quantification are explicit.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the verb before the masculine «متغير قضوي» from feminine to masculine.
repairs.rationale: The local head noun controlling agreement is masculine.
alternatives: Recasting the whole clause was unnecessary.

expert_review.reason: This is deterministic grammatical agreement.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the three predicates in the exercise list to nominative forms.
repairs.rationale: The revised construction no longer supplies an accusative governor.
alternatives: Removing all case marks was acceptable but less explicit than correcting them.

expert_review.reason: Arabic case government determines the forms.

repairs.chosen_repair: Used an independent final index n for the right-hand sequence.
repairs.rationale: The two sides of a sequent can have different lengths or either can be empty.
alternatives: Using p and q was equivalent; n was selected as the review’s minimal repair.

expert_review.reason: Independent sequence lengths require independent indices.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed «وكان كل ورقة» to «وكانت كل ورقة».
repairs.rationale: ورقة is feminine.
alternatives: No semantic alternative was needed.

expert_review.reason: This is deterministic gender agreement.

repairs.chosen_repair: Required every premise licensed by clause (2) in the derivation to belong to Γ, instead of defining Γ as exactly those used premises.
repairs.rationale: A derivation uses only finitely many assumptions, while Γ may be a larger or infinite premise set.
alternatives: Introducing a fresh finite Γ0 was possible but needlessly lengthened this definition.

expert_review.reason: Monotonic premise-set semantics fixes the inclusion direction.

repairs.chosen_repair: Restored the omitted negation before B in the two Example 3 candidate sequents only.
repairs.rationale: Conjunction-left changes the principal conjunction, not the unchanged disjunctive context shown in the following proof tree.
alternatives: A global replacement was rejected because the superficially similar formulas in Example 2 are correct.

expert_review.reason: The adjacent tree and rule schema determine the two corrections exactly.

repairs.chosen_repair: Introduced finite Γ0 and Γ1 subsets for the actual sequents, derived the converse witness from a finite Δ, described Γ1 unambiguously as one finite subset of Γ, and transferred both conclusions to the original Γ by monotonicity.
repairs.rationale: The proposition permits infinite Γ, whereas a printed sequent and its finite derivation use only finitely many premise formulas.
alternatives: Temporarily renaming the finite subset back to Γ was shorter but risked obscuring the transfer to the original premise set.

expert_review.reason: Finiteness of derivations and monotonicity give the repair constructively.

repairs.chosen_repair: Added weakening to both branches and exchange to the A branch before conjunction-right.
repairs.rationale: The stated conjunction-right rule requires identical contexts in both premises; the original paired axioms had unequal antecedents.
alternatives: Invoking an unstated context-splitting variant was rejected because it is not the rule marked in this reader.

expert_review.reason: The displayed rule schema determines the required structural steps.

repairs.chosen_repair: Separated left- and right-weakening equations for Θ and Ξ and repaired the two membership sentences so that the proposition, not the containing set, is the grammatical witness.
repairs.rationale: Right weakening leaves the antecedent unchanged; the earlier prose asserted only the left case and contained a category error in Arabic predication.
alternatives: Splitting the proof into two full cases was accurate but unnecessarily repetitive.

expert_review.reason: The two weakening rule displays fix the contexts exactly.

repairs.chosen_repair: Removed the duplicated conjunction from the propositional conditional branch.
repairs.rationale: The conjunction before the conditional already joins the rule names in both branches.
alternatives: Moving the conjunction inside both branches was equivalent but changed more source text.

expert_review.reason: Conditional expansion gives an objective duplicated particle.

repairs.chosen_repair: Added the existential-elimination exception for assumptions discharged by that rule to the eigenvariable-condition summary.
repairs.rationale: The detailed rule immediately above permits those temporary assumptions; omitting the exception makes the summary strictly too strong.
alternatives: Deleting the summary was rejected because it is useful teaching content.

expert_review.reason: The detailed rule fixes the exception unambiguously.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the plural terminology-token sentence to «فالاشتقاقات الآتية صحيحة».
repairs.rationale: Dual كلتا/الآتيتين was incompatible with the plural token realization.
alternatives: Replacing the token with an explicit dual noun was rejected because terminology traceability must be preserved.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed «هذان» to «هذه» before the plural derivations token.

expert_review.reason: The effective plural token realization determines agreement.

repairs.chosen_repair: Removed the noun duplicated by the derivations token and restored negation elimination to the introductory list of multiple-premise rules.
repairs.rationale: The token already supplies the noun; the later case list includes negation elimination, proving that only the signpost omitted it.
alternatives: Removing the later exercise case was rejected because the rule genuinely has two premises.

expert_review.reason: Token expansion and the complete subsequent case list determine both repairs.

repairs.chosen_repair: Changed the modifier after the plural derivations token from dual masculine to feminine singular plural agreement.
repairs.rationale: Nonhuman plural «اشتقاقات» takes feminine-singular agreement in this construction.
alternatives: Explicit dual «اشتقاقان منفصلان» was rejected because it would delete the terminology token.

expert_review.reason: The token expansion and agreement rule are explicit.
